arguments.body: Hello, thanks for your message about the washing machine. Because the current machine belongs to the landlord, fitting your own needs their consent, so we have put your offer to them, including that the new one would stay yours and go with you when you leave. We have also asked what should happen to the existing LG and who covers removal and fitting. Please don't remove or dispose of the LG until we confirm. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We will update you by 29 July.
